title: Binance Futures Will Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M MTLUSDT Perpetual Contract
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M MTLUSDT Perpetual Contract at  2023-06-06 16:15 (UTC) , as per the table below.  Existing positions  opened before the update  will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: MTLUSDT (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 21 - 25x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 21 - 25x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 11 - 20x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 11 - 20x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 600,000 5.00% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 600,000 5.00% 5x 600,000 < Position ≤ 1,600,000 10.00% 5x 600,000 < Position ≤ 1,600,000 10.00% 3 - 4x 1,600,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 12.50% 3 - 4x 1,600,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 12.50% 2x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 6,000,000 25.00% 2x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 4,000,000 25.00% 1x 6,000,000 < Position ≤ 10,000,000 50.00% 1x 4,000,000 < Position ≤ 6,000,000 50.00% Please Note :  In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M MTLUSDT Perpetual Contract  without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each  margin tier , updating  funding rates  such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the  Last Price Protected mechanism  to update the Mark Price.
